summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 gap closure (WinFsp extraction to crate), run a security review, add Rust test coverage, and get PR #352 merged-ready by fixing CI and resolving all reviewer comments.
summary.outcome: All 8 Phase 23 plans completed; 163 new Rust unit tests added across 3 crates; 2 HIGH security findings fixed; PR #352 created with all review threads resolved, though Windows CI failures required multiple iterations to fully resolve.

repo: Cargo [patch.crates-io] at workspace level resolves patched crates globally regardless of feature activation — vendored fuser compiled on Windows even when the 'fuse' feature was off
workspace.dependencies entries without 'default-features = false' propagate defaults to consumers even when the consumer specifies 'default-features = false' in their own dep block

cipherbox-fuse 'fuse' feature depends on dep:fuser; placing fuser under [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] breaks the feature definition on Windows because Cargo can't resolve 'dep:fuser' at feature parse time
The desktop fuse/mod.rs had an unused FolderEntry import that slipped through
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking were dead code in both platform paths (macOS/Linux and Windows operations.rs)
generate_ed25519_keypair returned bare Vec<u8> for the private key; callers were wrapping in Zeroizing::new() redundantly
ed25519-dalek missing 'zeroize' feature flag in workspace Cargo.toml — SigningKey was not zeroing on drop
IpnsPublishRequest derived Debug, leaking encrypted IPNS key material in debug output
ApiClient.get_bytes was dead code — defined but never called
Cross-language parity tests: @cipherbox/core imports @cipherbox/crypto types for DTS — crypto must build before core in CI

code.finding: generate_ed25519_keypair now returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> for private key; callers in write_ops.rs simplified to use directly
Was wrapping generate_ed25519_keypair result in redundant Zeroizing::new(); now uses Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> directly
ipns_private_key.try_into() on Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> requires .to_vec().try_into() since Zeroizing doesn't implement TryInto<[u8;32]> directly
Copy-paste bug: app_version field was being set to device_info.device_id (already moved) instead of app_version — required saving app_version/device_model before partial move
encode_libp2p_public_key had unsafe 'as u8' truncation on key length varint; changed to return Result with explicit 32-byte length validation
IpnsPublishRequest needs custom Debug impl that redacts ipns_private_key field
Temp dir cleanup was happening before unmount — should clean up after successful unmount in all return paths
Root workspace Cargo.toml dependency for cipherbox-fuse needed 'default-features = false' to prevent Windows builds from activating the 'fuse' feature through workspace dep resolution
Vendored fuser must compile as empty crate on non-Unix; used #[cfg(unix)] include!("lib_impl.rs") pattern to gate all content
Logout transport errors were propagated via ? before best-effort cleanup path — needed match to handle gracefully

workflow: When a GSD agent disconnects mid-execution, check git log and acceptance criteria before re-running — the code changes may already be committed and only bookkeeping (SUMMARY.md, STATE.md, ROADMAP.md) remains
1Password SSH agent signing fails intermittently; retry usually succeeds on 2nd or 3rd attempt

Cargo [patch.crates-io] cannot be made conditional on target — the only reliable way to prevent a patched crate from compiling on a non-target platform is to make the crate itself a no-op (empty lib.rs via cfg) or ensure no feature path activates it
cargo check --workspace --no-default-features does NOT override workspace.dependencies that omit default-features = false — both the workspace dep definition AND consumer must specify it
Moving optional deps to [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] breaks feature definitions that reference dep: — Cargo validates dep: references at feature resolution time before target filtering
pnpm --filter parallel builds don't respect inter-package dependency order; use sequential && when packages have build-time dependencies on each other
CodeRabbit generates new review threads on each push; budget time for multiple resolve-PR-comments rounds per PR
cargo llvm-cov --workspace in CI automatically picks up any new #[cfg(test)] modules added to workspace crates

friction: 1Password SSH agent failed signing on first attempt repeatedly throughout the session, requiring 2-3 retries per commit

Windows cargo check required 6+ iterations to fully fix — each fix revealed a deeper layer of Cargo feature resolution behavior (dep: in features, workspace default-features, [patch] global resolution)
GSD executor agent disconnected mid-plan due to API connection error, requiring manual resume and bookkeeping
CodeRabbit opened new review threads on each push (3 separate rounds of 6-11 threads each), creating significant review overhead
Cargo [patch.crates-io] documentation doesn't clearly explain that patched crates are always resolved/compiled even when no feature activates them as optional deps
Cross-language parity CI failure had a misleading error — appeared to be a pnpm version issue but was actually a build-order dependency
open_items: AES-CTR client-side CID integrity verification not implemented — client doesn't verify CID after fetching bytes, leaving a bit-flip attack surface for relay-controlled responses (MEDIUM finding from security review)
file_ipns_private_key in write_ops.rs uses ed25519_dalek SigningKey directly (not via generate_ed25519_keypair) — private key bytes not in Zeroizing wrapper
Security review found ~5 remaining MEDIUM/LOW findings documented in .planning/security/REVIEW-2026-03-24-phase23.md that were not addressed in this session
Vendored fuser lib_impl.rs approach is a significant deviation from upstream fuser — future fuser updates will require the same split manually
